div.div:
Legend
Official Azure2 / AWS4 catalog service icons; plain boxes where a service icon is inapplicable.
Boundaries = deployment or software-system domains.
Solid filled arrow = request / forwarding action; dashed filled arrow = auxiliary authentication / role query.
Normal response is folded into request labels. VPN legs 9a/9b are traffic routing.
No additional behavior is implied by icon placement or line routing.
